ask: Thread on any sewn item (cotton or polyester).
Wheels and axles on push toys and cars.
Colorants on rubber toys and dyed silks.
For merino or knitted wool, whether it's superwash (chemically coated).
Zippers and glue on mattresses and beds.

criteria.label: Plastic or synthetics in the main materials
criteria.help: Body, filling, batting, foam, lining, soles, insoles and waterproof layers.

criteria.label: Plastic in small parts
criteria.help: Thread, glue, zippers, elastic, axles, eyes and similar.

criteria.label: Plastic in lids, stands or optional extras
criteria.help: Pieces sold with the product that food or the child doesn't touch in normal use, such as a lid that sits on top or a removable cushion.

criteria.label: Synthetic dyes, paints or coatings
criteria.help: Undyed, unfinished, or finished with named natural dyes, oils or waxes.

criteria.label: Plywood, MDF or veneer
criteria.help: For wooden items: hides anything that is not solid wood.

criteria.label: Superwash or shrink-proofed wool
criteria.help: Wool sold as machine washable counts as superwash unless the seller says it is untreated.

criteria.label: Added flame retardant chemicals
criteria.help: Mattresses, pads and foam. A wool layer that meets flammability rules on its own is not a chemical treatment.

criteria.label: Silicone tested to LFGB or the French Arrêté
criteria.help: The maker says the finished product, not just the raw silicone, meets German LFGB or the French Arrêté of 25 November 1992.

criteria.label: Certified organic fibres or latex
criteria.help: Organic, GOTS or GOLS stated for the textiles or latex.

criteria.label: Natural rubber or latex
criteria.help: Includes natural latex foam in mattresses and natural rubber toys and boots.

criteria.label: Leather, suede or sheepskin
criteria.help: Includes leather soles and sheepskin insoles.

standards.label: US toy and child-product rules (ASTM, CPSIA)

aisles.title: Play
aisles.blurb: Wood, wool, cotton, silk and natural rubber, for 12 to 24 months.

aisles.title: Sleep
aisles.blurb: Cotton, wool, natural latex, coir and plain or oiled solid wood. Natural latex foam counts as natural. Superwash or "washable" wool without an untreated statement is outside the criteria.

aisles.title: Eat and drink
aisles.blurb: Silicone, measured against the bar in an r/Mommit post: an entry meets the criteria only if the brand says the finished product (not just the raw silicone) is LFGB-certified or meets the French Arrêté of 25 Nov 1992. "Platinum" or "LFGB silicone" alone counts as meeting most criteria. No entry has a published accredited-lab report, so each rests on the brand's own declaration.

aisles.title: Wear
aisles.blurb: Leather is included; the Leather switch under Material rules hides it. Sizes for 12 to 24 months are EU 20 to 23 (US 4 to 7 toddler). No maker states its thread or glue.

types.title: Padded play mats
types.intro: Many “organic” play mats contain polyester batting, foam or a plastic waterproof layer.

types.title: Activity and soft books
types.intro: Most cloth books use polyester filling, plastic crinkle film or an acrylic mirror; felt quiet books are usually acrylic felt with hook-and-loop; board books are glued and varnished.
types.outro: Another route for a felt quiet book is a custom order from an Etsy maker, specifying 100% wool felt, cotton thread and buttons instead of hook-and-loop.

types.title: Pounding bench
types.outro: No other pounding bench turned up without varnish, stain or paint.

types.title: Balls
types.intro: Natural rubber is a latex product. Almost every natural rubber ball is painted or dyed with a colourant the maker doesn't name.

types.title: Bath toys
types.intro: Natural rubber is a latex product.

types.title: Silks for peekaboo and pretend play
Mattresses
types.intro: Every layer is latex, coir, wool or cotton. All fit a standard crib or toddler bed (about 28 x 52 in) unless noted.

types.title: Toddler beds that take a crib mattress
types.intro: Solid wood with no finish or a plant-oil finish, and no plywood or MDF. The entries describe the unfinished or oil-finish options; painted or stained versions are made differently.

types.title: Low twin floor beds
types.outro: Taller adult-style twin frames also meet the material criteria but sit higher, for an older child: Savvy Rest Afton (from $1,049), Puritas Perfect Platform at Shepherd's Dream (from $1,305) and Vermont Woods Vergennes ($1,752).

types.title: Mattress pads, toppers and protectors
types.intro: A felted wool pad is the natural stand-in for a plastic waterproof cover: it soaks up and slows leaks rather than blocking them. Every waterproof crib protector found has a polyurethane or TPU film. Toddler pillows are usually started around age 2.

types.title: Baby food and breast milk freezer trays
types.intro: Béaba is the one brand here whose claim covers the finished tray, and only in emails the brand sent to Reddit users. Béaba US can be asked for the Declaration of Conformity or migration test report for a specific tray.

types.title: Ice cube trays
types.intro: Silikomart, an Italian maker, is the one brand that publicly lists the French silicone decree and German LMBG migration tests, and its moulds came out clean in UFC-Que Choisir's 2022 lab test. Both claims cover the brand, not a named tray.

types.title: Ice pop and freezer molds
types.intro: Liewood publishes a declaration for this exact product saying the finished pops were migration-tested to EU limits under LFGB; the other entries rely on brand-wide statements.

types.title: Shoes and slippers
types.intro: No maker states its thread or glue. Well-known shoes with TPR or synthetic rubber outsoles are listed under the items that miss the default filters.

types.title: Rain boots
types.intro: No brand publishes its glue, thread or rubber additives. Bisgaard lists natural rubber or cotton for every part it names. Natural rubber is a latex product.
types.outro: Makers can answer the open questions. glerups can say what its thread and glue are, Padraig whether the wool is superwash, and Bisgaard (contact@bisgaardshoes.dk) what is under the cotton insole and in the rubber compound.
